description: Proves an outbound SMS was sent from a provisioned number to an exact destination

judges.description: TRUE if evidence contains sms_outbound class with number_commitment, destination_commitment, nonce, and sent_at

gates.description: Evidence must be within freshness window

critical_rules: Provider's send acknowledgement is evidence, not proof
Independent readback from recipient is required for TRUE
If send succeeds but recipient readback unavailable => UNKNOWN
The exact sender number and destination must match the claim
